opening: I keep getting xanthomas, fatty lumps in my skin; they keep coming back.
They first appeared before I was 10.
They were surgically removed several times when I was a teenager.
My mother died suddenly at 60; it was possibly from early coronary artery disease.
My sister had xanthomas as a child.

opening.text: I keep getting xanthomas, which are fatty lumps in my skin, and they keep coming back. They first appeared before I was 10, and I had them surgically removed several times when I was a teenager. My Achilles tendons are thickened now. My mother died suddenly at 60, possibly from early coronary artery disease, and my sister had xanthomas as a child.
